
cmake_minimum_required( VERSION 3.22 FATAL_ERROR )

project( "llama-main" LANGUAGES CXX )

#set( AE_EXTERNAL_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." )
#include( "${AE_EXTERNAL_PATH}/config.cmake" )

set( CPU_TYPE		"0"  	CACHE STRING 	"CPU type with assotiated feature set" )
set( ENABLE_VULKAN	OFF		CACHE BOOL 		"enable Vulkan backend" )

set( GGML_ACCELERATE 		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( GGML_CPU		 		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( GGML_OPENMP			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( GGML_BACKEND_DL		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( GGML_BUILD_EXAMPLES	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( GGML_BUILD_TESTS		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( GGML_NATIVE			OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( GGML_STATIC			OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )

set( LLAMA_ALL_WARNINGS		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( LLAMA_BUILD_COMMON		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( LLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( LLAMA_BUILD_SERVER		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( LLAMA_BUILD_TESTS		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( LLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )	# include CLI & server
set( LLAMA_CURL				OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( LLAMA_FATAL_WARNINGS	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )	# some projects failed to compile

# CPU
if (${CPU_TYPE} STREQUAL "1")
	set( GGML_SSE42			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX			OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX2			OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_BF16	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VBMI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VNNI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	message( STATUS "<<<< build GGML backend: CPU SSE4" )

elseif (${CPU_TYPE} STREQUAL "2")
	set( GGML_SSE42			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX2			OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_BF16	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VBMI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VNNI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	message( STATUS "<<<< build GGML backend: CPU AVX1" )

elseif (${CPU_TYPE} STREQUAL "3")
	set( GGML_SSE42			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX2			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_BF16	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VBMI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VNNI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	message( STATUS "<<<< build GGML backend: CPU AVX2" )

elseif (${CPU_TYPE} STREQUAL "4")
	set( GGML_SSE42			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX2			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_BF16	ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	message( STATUS "<<<< build GGML backend: CPU AVX512 BF16" )

elseif (${CPU_TYPE} STREQUAL "5")
	set( GGML_SSE42			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX2			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_BF16	ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VBMI	ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VNNI	ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	message( STATUS "<<<< build GGML backend: CPU AVX512 BF16 VBMI VNNI" )

elseif (${CPU_TYPE} STREQUAL "6")
	set( GGML_SSE42			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX2			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_BF16	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VBMI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX512_VNNI	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_AVX_VNNI		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	message( STATUS "<<<< build GGML backend: CPU AVX2 VNNI" )
else()
	message( FATAL_ERROR "unsupported CPU_TYPE: ${CPU_TYPE}" )
endif()

# Vulkan
if (${ENABLE_VULKAN})
	set( GGML_VULKAN				ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	set( GGML_VULKAN_CHECK_RESULTS	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )	# failed to compile
	set( GGML_VULKAN_RUN_TESTS		OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
	message( STATUS "<<<< build GGML backend: Vulkan GPU" )
endif()

include( "origin_CMakeLists.txt" )
